description: Minecraft mod adding therapeutic bath fluids with healing, buffs, and temperature mod integrations — 1.8M+ downloads on CurseForge. Supports Forge 1.20.1 & NeoForge 1.21.1+

mods.name: Hot Bath
mods.description:
Oh joyous day, when one may immerse
In waters pure and crystal clear.
To wash away the grime and dirt,
And leave the body fresh and sheer.

The Minecraft world doth offer up
A wealth of streams and rivers fair.
But lo, a bath of one's design
Is where true luxury lies there.

The joy of soaking in warm suds,
Of feeling water's gentle touch,
Of letting go the day's fatigue
And feeling one's whole being flush.

A time to contemplate and muse,
Or sing a tune or two aloud,
Or simply float and drift away,
In peaceful silence, free and proud.

So let us revel in this gift,
Of Minecraft baths, so fine and rare.
And bask in all their cleansing bliss,
With not a worry nor a care.

releases.notes:
Development preview for **Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge** and **1.21.1 / NeoForge**.

If using ShowerCore, install [the matching ShowerCore 1.2.0 preview](https://github.com/CrabMods/ShowerCore/releases/tag/v1.2.0-preview.20261021).

Choose the JAR for your Minecraft version. Replace old copies and keep one JAR per mod; use the same pair on the server and clients.

Changes since 4.1.2:

- Shared liquid properties, effect timing and optional-mod behavior between world fluids and external bathtubs/pools through Bath API 4.2.0.
- Datapack-configurable built-in bath behavior, dirtiness effect ranges and source conversion; local dirt/fly display controls.
- Bath benefits for eligible friendly mobs, including stationary occupants; four growth stages for bath herbs planted on dirt.
- Correct per-liquid names and preserved white, black and transparent custom-fluid colors.

Validation of the matched pair: **412 JVM tests**, **346 core container GameTest methods** across both loaders, plus standalone liquid, seasonal and Forge Alex's Caves checks. Actual clients covered **18 base and 19 optional-mod scenarios per loader**, including Cold Sweat, Tough As Nails, Legendary Survival Overhaul and Farmer's Delight.

[English final verification report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CrabMods/ShowerCore/1063829e4153e83a97023aad28c012ae182961ff/validation/issue-56/bath-api-4.2.0-final-report-en.mp4) — actual game frames held for comparison.

Dedicated multiplayer and shader-pack compatibility are outside this validation. SHA-256 checksums are attached.

Source snapshots: [NeoForge 1.21.1](https://github.com/CrabMods/hotBath/commit/17a90640f26c4d3606cbff968798c8cab9b02c4e), [Forge 1.20.1](https://github.com/CrabMods/hotBath/commit/7d284519936b53c125756d95cb6ea3db4545a46a).

releases.notes:
# Hot Bath 4.1.2

Bug fixes since 4.1.1 for Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1.

- Fixed Hot Water Bucket heating recipes with Thirst Was Reclaimed and Polymorph. (#43, #49)
- Fixed missing localized bath fluid names. (#34)
- Fixed dirt overlay texture selection for some players and crouching alignment with Fresh Animations/EMF. (#72, #44)
- Fixed custom bath colors and opacity in Create tanks/spouts, and kept bath bottles upright on belts/depots. (#77, #80)
- Fixed Create honey, herbal and milk bath mixing ingredients on Forge. (#83)
- Preserved custom bath identity and fluid amounts through Create pipes and hose pulleys, including waterlogged blocks, incompatible drains and large fills. (#86, #89, #92, #94, #106)
- Fixed missed bath effects and extinguishing from short Create pipe bursts. (#100)
- Fixed stacked bath sources being overwritten and incomplete custom bath catalogs during synchronization. (#97, #103)
- Kept filled buckets when placement is rejected and respected Adventure waterlogging permissions on 1.21.1. (#109, #112)

releases.notes:
# Hot Bath 4.1.1

Patch release for Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge and Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge.

## Fixed

- Restored ordinary water and lava bucket filling when Hot Bath is installed, including Create Spouts.
- Restored fluid capabilities for built-in bath buckets and dynamic datapack bath buckets.
- Fixed Create Spout filling of stacked empty buckets while preserving the bath fluid identity.
- Kept legacy bucket metadata unchanged during reads and simulated transactions; invalid bath fluid IDs do not consume buckets or fluid.

## Validation and remaining scope

Both branches passed JVM regression tests, 30 native Create filling transactions and 20 real Spout/emptying transactions in a hidden client across 10 fluids. Tested with Create 6.0.9 on NeoForge 1.21.1 and Create 6.0.8 on Forge 1.20.1. Test and recording harnesses are excluded from the production JARs.

Recipe-viewer GUI behavior and other Create compatibility work remain under review in [#47](https://github.com/crabsatellite/hotBath/issues/47) and [#33](https://github.com/crabsatellite/hotBath/issues/33). This release does not claim full modpack acceptance.

## Credits

Thanks to [FriedCoder-Awesome](https://github.com/FriedCoder-Awesome) for the original fix in [#73](https://github.com/crabsatellite/hotBath/pull/73). The equivalent Forge 1.20.1 fix was merged in [#74](https://github.com/crabsatellite/hotBath/pull/74).

## Downloads

- `hotbath-1.21.1-4.1.1.jar` — Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge.
- `hotbath-1.20.1-4.1.1.jar` — Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge.

releases.notes:
## Hot Bath 4.1.0

This release collects the fixes and compatibility work accumulated after the previous CurseForge 4.0.1 release.

### Downloads

- `hotbath-1.21.1-4.1.0.jar` - Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge
- `hotbath-1.20.1-4.1.0.jar` - Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge

### Fixed / Improved

- Fixed the Epic Fight dedicated-server invalid-dist startup issue (#32).
- Updated Tough As Nails bottle datapack integration (#36).
- Added waterlogged bath-effect handling for Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge; #34 remains open for tester confirmation and Jade display follow-up.
- Added missing bath block localization keys.
- Added public external bath fluid API helpers so other mods can integrate with Hot Bath fluids without Hot Bath hardcoding every furniture mod.
- Added initial Create/custom-fluid compatibility work, including custom fluid stack handling and custom fluid ID preservation.
- Clarified waterlogging documentation and version support.

### Known Issues

- Create compatibility is not fully solved yet. Remaining Create behavior is tracked in #33.
- Unofficial ports or incompatible third-party builds are not supported unless there is an official target version/API to integrate against.
